'''Blubbles''' is a [[Water]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Dolphie]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Aquariel]] at 18 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Each time Blubbles returns to the bay, small wooden planks carrying flowers and seashells float across the water. The petals scatter and drift as Blubbles swims through, leaving the harbor a little liveleier than before."

Blubbles is a gold rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Blubbles's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Aquariel]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Blubbles to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (Use Fishing Rod x2000) or [[Zobo Shooter]] (Use Bullet Coin x200000).

== Trivia ==
* Blubbles and its evolutions were added to the game on 9/23/2026 alongside [[Thunderpaw]] and [[Cinderclaw]].
